subject: C/Rust region layout mismatch and missing exact image-view facts
body: Additional stable C/Rust contract issues in current draft (not reporting transient half-written syntax): TeguAIRComputeRegion C has groups[3],constant_count; Rust ComputeRegion adds flags BEFORE constant_count. Thus offsets differ and every array region disagrees. With NativeConstant16bytes, C region1168 versus Rust1172; dispatch alignment includes8-byte ComputeDescriptor fields, so asserted NativeDispatchV2==8676 is inconsistent (C current10696, Rust current10728 on64bit). Add matching sizeof/offsetof assertions on both boundaries. ComputeDescriptor also has no exact ImageViewDesc format/components/level/twin/shader_swizzle or SamplerUse compare/integer facts, so callers cannot build the bound variant descriptors faithfully. Please include them or expose an explicit validated per-use descriptor contract; never infer from texture ownformat alone. compute_texture_span row_stride*height*depth*array omits mips, MS samples, compressed blockrows and cube-face expansion. Do not create a second layout algorithm; consume common validated subresource spans or accept exact full backing facts while common packer independently proves every range. STORAGE does not imply WRITE: current usage check requires SHADER_WRITE for read-only storage image and should follow actual access WRITE. These are review requests for your in-progress code; no build by audit.
